title: The Wall on the d-File
setup: Your c-pawn has a long way to go, and Black's king on e5 is walking over to meet it. One rook move decides whether it ever arrives.
hint: Count the files between Black's king and your pawn. The king has to cross one of them first, so make it yours.
explanation:
## The Idea

Only the d-file separates Black's king from your pawn's road, so {{Rd1}} takes it. The king on e5 may not step onto a square the rook covers, and now it covers the whole file: the king is penned on the far side for as long as the rook stays.

Your king then walks up beside the c-pawn and escorts it home. Any other move lets Black's king cross to the d-file and get in front of the pawn, and the ending is a draw.
